description: This file defines Swagger API documentation classes for user management endpoints in the Fineract project, including request and response schemas for user-related operations.

classes.name: UsersApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes defining Swagger schemas for user API responses and requests.

classes.name: GetUsersResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response when retrieving user list.

classes.name: GetUsersUserIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response when retrieving a specific user by ID.

classes.name: GetUsersTemplateResponse
classes.description: Schema for the template data for user creation/editing.

classes.name: PostUsersRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new user.

classes.name: PostUsersResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after creating a user.

classes.name: PutUsersUserIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after updating user details.

classes.name: DeleteUsersUserIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after deleting a user.
